data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting result was a loss of GBP 28.2m, of which GBP 22.8m is in respect of the 2018 and prior years of account. The main driver of this deterioration was a substantial increase in new large and cat claims, particularly in the fourth quarter. Additional reserves were booked in relation to COVID-19 at GBP 12.0m net, of which GBP 7.2m related to 2018 and prior years of account.

named_events.loss_description: Gross loss to syndicate 22.5; Net loss to syndicate 12.0; reserves held at year end for COVID-19 are GBP 12.0m net (UK Travel GBP 0.6m, UK BI GBP 8.8m, US GBP 1.7m, Australian GBP 0.9m).
Hurricane Laura - gross loss to syndicate 2.5; net loss to syndicate 2.5.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 160.783m. During 2020 the syndicate recorded a material adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 114.4m (strengthening), driven principally by substantial increases in large and catastrophe claims (notably during Q4) and additional COVID-19 related reserves. The 2018 year of account, and prior years, were particularly impacted. The deterioration affected property/business interruption exposures and casualty lines and was compounded by legal uncertainty on COVID-19 BI coverage and related reinsurance recoveries.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle in the notes (page 20) by comparing the current cumulative incurred for underwriting years 2013-2018 to the previous diagonal (per Lloyd's triangle method). There is no single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' note. The Part VII / RITC activity and transfers described in the report may distort some comparative movements; the triangle appears to be the best available gross source. COVID-19 amounts quoted elsewhere in the report are presented net of reinsurance; where only net figures were available these were not used for the gross PYD calculation.
